work.description: Historical collected-volume container holding Aquinas's lectures on Matthew and on John as printed in the second Venetian edition, with Bernardo Maria de Rubeis's prefatory Admonitio on the authenticity of the Matthew commentary. The two commentaries remain separate constituent works and are not yet registered as such.
